index.intro: Pick a family, a field, and invariants. No install needed. For heavier work, run pip install quiverlab.
job.title: Job
job.report_problem: Report a problem with this computation
about.body: A public interface to the quiverlab library for quivers with relations and exact Hochschild theory. Every number is exact; the library fails loudly rather than approximate.
about.cite: Cite: see the JOSS paper linked from the repository.
fb.intro: Report a problem or suggest a feature. No account needed.
lit.intro: The curated bibliography behind quiverlab's algorithms and families, grouped by topic.
big.warn: This computation builds ~{cells}-cell matrices (~{minutes} min) — beyond the anonymous limit. Enter an email and we'll run it as a big job and email you when it's done.
big.disabled: This computation builds ~{cells}-cell matrices — beyond the anonymous limit, and large jobs are unavailable right now. Run it locally: pip install quiverlab.
big.reject: This computation builds ~{cells}-cell matrices, beyond the large-job limit of ~{maxcells} cells. Run it locally: pip install quiverlab.
big.sent: Check your inbox for a one-time link to run this job.
big.link_used: This link was already used or has expired. Submit the job again to get a new one.
big.queued: Your big job is queued. We'll email you when it's done — bookmark this page for the results.
